Accused    Loh "u Chow    (    ) A c... proprietor of the
                                Lu "ow Bookstore,
                                221 Shantung Rd.

Summons    Exposing indecent books for sale. contr. to Art. 235 - c 2
           of the ....
           For that he being the proprietor of the Lu Chow Bookstore
           in Shanghai, did on Oct. 10, 1938 expose for sale copies of
           two indecent books entitled 'Yao Kwang Pi Chi' and 'Secrets of
           a Nunnery' and 'Vi Keh Isen Ping Zoong Zeu'.
           ...C/P.

IN SUMMARY COURT No. 4 (A.M.)

Mr. Tsien appeared for the P.O.

Proceedings:-    Mr. Tsien:- The accused is charged under Art. 235
                 of the J.C.C. for exposing indecent books for sale. The accused
                 exposed for sale copies of two indecent books entitled "Yao
                 Kwang Pi Chi" and "Vi Keh Isen Ping Zoong Zeu" in his Lu Chow
                 Bookstore No. 221 Shantung Road. The Police discovered it and
                 acting on a Search Warrant they proceeded to his bookstore for
                 search where over copies were seized and they are not being
                 detained by the Court. A Summons was applied for by the Police
                 and the accused is now summoned to this Court to answer the
                 charge.

                 Judge to accused:-
                 Q. Are you the proprietor of the Lu Chow Bookstore?
                 A. Yes.
                 Q. On the 10/10/38 did you expose for sale copies of two in-
                    decent books entitled "Yao Kwang Pi Chi" and "Vi Keh Isen Ping
                    Zoong Zeu" in your bookstore?
                 A. They were mailed to us by a bookstore at Tientsin. Here is
                    the advertisement(pro). I did not know the contents of the books.
                 Q. Were the books seized from your bookstore?
                 A. Yes.

传票    陈列淫秽书籍出售。违反 ____ 第235条第2款
           指控其作为上海Lu Chow书店的店主，于1938年10月10日陈列出售两本名为《瑶光秘记》和《尼姑庵的秘密》以及《未刻珍品丛传》 ____ C/P的淫秽书籍副本。

在第4简易法庭 (上午)

钱先生代表公诉人出庭。

诉讼过程：-    钱先生：- 被告被控违反《中华民国刑法》第235条，陈列淫秽书籍出售。被告在其位于山东路221号的Lu Chow书店陈列出售两本名为《瑶光秘记》和《Vi Keh Isen Ping Zoong Zeu》的淫秽书籍副本。警方发现后，依据搜查令前往其书店进行搜查，查获了更多副本，这些副本目前未被法庭扣押。警方申请了传票，被告现被传唤至本庭应诉。

                 法官问被告：-
                 问：你是Lu Chow书店的店主吗？
                 答：是的。
                 问：1938年10月10日，你是否在你的书店陈列出售两本名为《瑶光秘记》和《Vi Keh Isen Ping Zoong Zeu》的淫秽书籍副本？
                 答：这些书是天津一家书店寄给我们的。这是广告(pro)。我不知道书的内容。
                 问：这些书是从你的书店查获的吗？
                 答：是的。

File No. ____ POLICE LIBRARY
Date Nov. 23, 1938.

Subject (in full) Proprietor of Wu Chow Bookstore fined $20 for exposing
for sale indecent books.

Made by and Forwarded by D. S. McKeown.

Further to the attached file, Loh Wu-chow (卜五洲),
proprietor of the Wu Chow Bookstore (五洲書報社), No. 221 Shantung
Road, who was proceeded against by the Municipal Police on
summons under Article 235 Section 2 of the Chinese Criminal
Code for exposing for sale copies of two indecent books
entitled "Yao Kwang Pi Chi" ("Secrets of a Nunnery" 瑤光秘記)
and "Vi Keh Tsen Ping Zeong Zeu" (未刻珍品叢傳) in his
bookstore on November 10, appeared before the Shanghai First
Special District Court on November 23 when he was sentenced
to a fine of $20 or 20 days detention.

D. C. (Special Branch).

D. S.

IN SUMMARY COURT NO. (A.M.)
Mr. Tsien appeared for the S.M.C.

Proceedings

Mr. Tsien:- The S.5 of the Special Branch of the
S.M.P. ascertained that the Wu Chow Bookstore at no.221
Shantung Road have two books on sale. A search warrant
was applied for and acting on the authority of search
warrant No.3677 (handed in to the court) police proceeded
to 221 Shantung Road at 2.30 p.m.yesterday. It was
ascertained that the owner of the bookshop is one named
Pei Ho Chow. As the result of the search, 13 copies of
a book entitled "Yao Kwang Pih Ki" and 11 copies of another
book entitled "Vi Yeh Tseu Ping Yoong You" were seized
on the premises. These books are found to be indecent
in nature. Please detain these books, while the police
will apply for the issue of a summons for the owner to
appear in court.

Acting on the authority of a search warrant no.3677
issued by the Shanghai First Special District Court at the
instance of the Shanghai Municipal Police, D.S. McKeown,
C.D.C.230 Chang Yeh, C.D.C.280 Li Hai-feng and Clerk Chiang
King-yong (S.5), accompanied by D.S. Francis and C.D.C.101

Wu Chow Bookstore (五洲書報社), 221 Shantung Road, and seized
the following indecent books:-

Nunnery") .................................... 13 copies

First Special District Court on November 11, when an application

Part I - Page 13

        I had just recovered from a ten-day illness. One
morning I went to my tutor's room to ask for some vegetable
food and medicine. I found the room empty. Being a favoured
pupil of my tutor, I was often given free access to things.
I opened a jar and took out a small quantity of bamboo shoots.
I also opened a drawer and took out a lacquered box to look
for medicine but found none except a small packet wrapped with
a pink napkin.

        Thinking that it might contain medicine, I unwrapped
it and found a number of indecent pictures. I was surprised
as well as pleased. The men and women in the pictures were
all naked and were embracing one another. Although there was
no other person in the dark room, I could feel my face flushing
while my hands began to tremble.

        One of the pictures was very clear; it depicted a male
holding his penis and about to thrust it into the vagina, for
the penis was just touching the "lip" as if ignorant of the
route. The female in the picture was on her back with her
legs wide apart, while one of her hands was guiding the penis.
I felt alarmed and began to wonder how such a thing which
urinates a stream of water thin as a thread could contain
such a large and long thing. I looked at other pictures only
to find that the two things had become united.

----------

Part I - Pages 29-30

        A hot night three months later. The air is still and
I could not sleep. I got up and walked along the corridor to
get some air. When I approached my tutor's room, I heard a
slight noise made by the bamboo bed. I stopped and listened.
At first I heard a noise like moaning and after a while I

第一部分 - 第13页

        我刚从十天的病中恢复。一天早晨，我去导师的房间要些素食和药。我发现房间空无一人。作为导师的宠徒，我经常可以自由取用物品。我打开一个罐子，取出少量竹笋。我还打开一个抽屉，拿出一个漆盒寻找药物，但除了一个用粉色餐巾包裹的小包外，什么也没找到。

        我想里面可能装着药，便解开包裹，发现了一些淫秽图片。我又惊又喜。图片中的男女都赤身裸体，互相拥抱。虽然黑暗的房间里没有其他人，但我感到脸上发烧，双手开始颤抖。

        其中一张图片非常清晰；描绘了一名男子手持阴茎，正要插入阴道，因为阴茎刚刚触碰到“唇”，仿佛不知路径。图片中的女子仰卧，双腿大开，一只手引导着阴茎。我感到惊慌，开始纳闷，这样一个尿出细如丝线水流的东西，怎么能容纳如此巨大且长的物体。我看其他图片，发现那两样东西已经结合在一起。

---

第一部分 - 第29-30页

There was another person whose voice was coarse and who was

like a crab foaming or the lapping of congee by a cat.

I stood outside the window in wonder. My heart was
pounding and I felt something like a hot breath coursing down
to the lower part of my body, while in my "quiet hole" I
experienced an uncontrollable ticklish sensation. I loosened
my trousers, touched my private organ and felt the two swelling
"petals" and found the "ditch" wet and hot.

Part I - Page 33

Despite his age, which was past 60, the old man Chow
(周) was still full of enthusiasm. His fourth concubine once
told me that the old man was already impotent and his "thing"
would not rise unless he took some medicine. The concubine
added that when she was deflowered, the old man "explored the
spring" with his finger and "dug open the door", after which
he used his tongue like a Weinan (渭南) dog lapping up a
medicine pot. The old man kept a number of pretty boys and
did not mind the flirtation between the boys and the concubines,
but immediately after he would order the boys to leave and make
the girl lie down face upwards with a pillow under her buttocks.
He would then bend down and suck up all the fluid.

----------

Part I - Page 52

I was in a state of ecstasy. The young man placed his
"portruding thing" into my "hollow". It was painful; it hurt.
After a while he discharged, cleaned himself with a napkin and
rose. I felt some icy sticky matter between my legs. I
returned to my room and fetched a jar of hot water and bathed.

我惊奇地站在窗外。我的心怦怦直跳，感到有一种像热气一样的东西流向我的下半身，而在我的“幽穴”里，我感到一种无法控制的痒感。我解开裤子，触摸了我的私处，感觉到两片肿胀的“花瓣”，发现“沟壑”又湿又热。

---

第一部分 - 第 33 页

尽管周（Chow）老头年过六旬，但他仍然充满热情。他的四姨太曾告诉过我，这老头已经阳痿了，除非吃药，否则他的“那话儿”就起不来。姨太还补充说，当她被破身时，老头用手指“探泉”并“掘门”，之后他像一只舔药锅的渭南（Weinan）狗一样使用舌头。老头养了许多娈童，并不介意娈童与姨太们调情，但随后他会立即命令娈童离开，让女孩仰面躺下，在臀部下垫一个枕头。然后他会弯下腰，吸尽所有的液体。

---

第一部分 - 第 52 页

我处于一种销魂的状态。那个年轻人把他的“突出之物”放进我的“空穴”里。很痛；真的很疼。过了一会儿，他排出了（精液），用手帕擦拭了身体并起身。我感到腿间有一些冰凉粘稠的物质。我回到房间，取了一罐热水洗了澡。

Part II - Page 91

I walked silently towards the window and peeped through
a hole. I saw my tutor standing by the side of the bed, while
Mr. Chang (  ), the benefactor of the nunnery, assisted her in
removing her clothing. When my tutor was taking off her pants,
Mr. Chang thrust one of his hands into her breeches. After
removing her pants, my tutor lay face upwards on the bed. Mr.
Chang opened her legs wide apart and stood between the two
legs. He bent his body slightly **〔此处转录不清〕** downwards over my tutor
and began to move. My tutor encircled his waist with her feet.
Then the movements started. At first they were slow but later
were quickened. A noise like "chih-chih" could be heard.
After a while, I saw my tutor's legs tighten their grip around
Mr. Chang's waist. Mr. Chang began to pant. After a while
he lay over my tutor's body. Soon afterwards, my tutor
produced a napkin from under the bed sheet and gave it to
Mr. Chang who cleaned himself. This done, he handed the
napkin back to my tutor. She bent her knees. As her private
organ faced the window, I saw it very clearly. It opened and
closed just like a shell bathing under the sun, while a white
fluid was oozing from it and the grassy part around it was
wet with dew. She then wiped the part with the napkin.

第二部分 - 第 91 页

我悄无声息地走向窗户，从一个洞里往里窥视。我看到我的导师站在床边，而尼姑庵的施主张（Chang）先生（ ）正协助她脱掉衣服。当我的导师脱裤子时，张先生把一只手伸进她的内裤里。脱掉裤子后，我的导师仰面躺在床上。张先生把她的双腿叉开，站在两腿之间。他身体略微**〔此处转录不清〕**向下俯在我的导师身上，开始动作。我的导师用脚环绕着他的腰。接着动作开始了。起初很慢，但后来加快了。可以听到“唧唧”的声音。过了一会儿，我看到导师的双腿紧紧夹住张先生的腰。张先生开始喘气。过了一会儿，他趴在导师的身上。不久之后，我的导师从床单下拿出一块手帕交给张先生，张先生清理了身体。完成后，他把手帕还给我的导师。她弯曲双膝。由于她的私处正对着窗户，我看得非常清楚。它一张一合，就像在阳光下沐浴的贝壳，而一种白色的液体正从中渗出，周围的草丛部分被露水打湿了。然后她用手帕擦拭了那个部位。
